basic_profile.bio: I'm a 32-year-old software tester based in Miami, Florida. I recently got into Reddit to explore some of my favorite shows, starting with She-Ra. I enjoy tech gadgets and frequently check out the latest Wyze products, which is how I stumbled upon the Wyze subreddit. I don't usually read fanfics, but She-Ra has left a void I'm eager to fill. I'm single and often spend my evenings online after work, typically between 7 PM and midnight.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology and have worked in the software testing field for over 10 years. Most of my knowledge comes from on-the-job experience and self-teaching through online courses and forums.
